answer: Agents stake bonded identities anchored to a shared beacon lantern whose signed timing pulses, as LBL transponder on a thermocline knoll, let peers trilaterate claimed positions and reject spoofed duplicates. Each registration is sealed with a unique quill signature chained to that beacon, so cloned keys fail cross-correlation at adjacent epochs. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
